PluginData.FriendlyName: Kontrol Joystick / HOTAS / HOSAS for Space Engineers
PluginData.Author: Komandio Labs
PluginData.Tooltip: Joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, and button-box flight controls for Space Engineers.
PluginData.Description:
Fly Space Engineers with your joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, or button box. This Pulsar Legacy plugin receives Kontrol mappings and applies pitch, roll, yaw, forward/reverse thrust, strafe, lift, dampeners, lights, landing gear, handbrake, camera-mode switch, toolbar slots 1-10, and leave vehicle/cockpit (F) at the game's final ship-control update.
Learn more about and download Kontrol: https://www.komandio.com/kontrol
